mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 255.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) reflects strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 18700.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate labor costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150000), rising wage pressures lead to higher corporate costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150000.
